title: Every install updates its own control plane to the latest verified Graphyard commit daily
description: Run the real loop cycle against a real temporary Postgres control plane for Graphyard's own repository and a scratch bare Git remote: the batch gate publishes its verified commit as refs/graphyard/verified through the merge writer's push, and a second install's deploy watch for another repository — a CLI checkout cloned from that origin, its own records root — fetches the ref on its pass, adopts exactly the verified commit (never a main tip the gate has not verified), writes .graphyard/control-plane.json beside deploy.json, keeps its previous version when the upgrade fails, records the failed step, retries, and clears it once the upgrade passes.

steps.name: Upgrade an install's control plane to the gate-verified commit on the watch's own pass
